consumers.method: executable-LOAD-segment exhaustive E8/E9 scan with objdump confirmation

stored_references.role: the routine is stored in a vtable slot, so it is reached through virtual dispatch, not by a direct call

consumers.stored_references_note: the .data.rel.ro file bytes are zeroed in this materialized binary, so the relocation records are the stored references

dispatch_guard.compared_value: the first qword of the value at object+0x10
dispatch_guard.fallback: when the compared value differs, tail-jump to that value with rdi unchanged
dispatch_guard.match: when the compared value equals 0x5d55970, run the inline destruction below

inline_destruction.release_helper_contract: the shared refcount release established in the RE-001 three-release packet: null-skipped by the caller, not by the helper

relation_to_derived_pair.derived_pair: 0x5d55970 / 0x5d559c0, pinned in the RE-001 derived-destructor packet
relation_to_derived_pair.offset_mapping: the subobject at object+0x10 has its +0x38 field at object+0x48 and its +0x28 field at object+0x38, so the two releases and the two vptr writes here are exactly the derived destructor applied to that subobject
relation_to_derived_pair.shared_base: 0x5fe70b0, the base destructor the derived pair also delegates to

arguments.rdi: object whose +0x10 slot holds the embedded object's vptr

routine.returns: nothing; both exits are tail jumps
